Implement FieldIssue V2 frontend now in [local path removed] You are not alone in the codebase. Own apps/web/** and root package.json/package-lock.json workspace/build changes ONLY. Do not revert others. No commits/push/deploy, no secret files, no provider API calls. Root agent owns backend, shared contracts, Dockerfiles, docs. Read docs/fieldissue-v2-prd.md as full specification; prioritize complete P0 browser flow and polished responsive distinct landing/dashboard, then Lab and useful P1 surfaces. Preserve existing API contracts by reading apps/api/src/app.ts, service.ts, repository.ts, packages/shared/src. Use React+TS+Vite, Tailwind, actual shadcn components via CLI, Motion for React, lazy Leaflet/OSM. Read skills [local path removed] and shadcn-best-practices/SKILL.md. npm installs are yours; root will not install concurrently. Build result apps/web/dist; public asset may copy existing apps/api/assets/field-walk.png if useful clearly illustrative, don't require generated assets. Root serves SPA with same origin backend; Vite dev proxy /v1,/media,/app-config,/ready,/health to http://127.0.0.1:3000. Use only REAL API data, no seeded display records/fake provider activity. Shared token interactive unlock stored sessionStorage, never hardcode or print it. Protected media needs authorized fetch/blob URL cleanup, images cannot bearer-fetch directly. Support /, /app/explore, /app/report, /app/report/review, /app/issues/:id, /app/issues/:id/revisit, /app/issues/:id/compare, /app/issues/:id/resolve, /app/walk, /app/lab, /about,/methodology,/privacy. Login can appear inside app shell, public landing stays distinct.
Backend additions root will implement: GET /v1/walks/suggestions?latitude=&longitude=&radius_meters=2000&limit=5 => {items:[{issueId,title,distanceMeters,status,lastObservedAt}],sortingMethod:'distance_then_age',routeCalculated:false}. GET /v1/model-lab/evaluations => {evaluations:[{id,title,model,dataset,metrics,limitations,serving:false}]}. GET /v1/integrations/status => {integrations:[{id,name,status,detail}],coreReady:boolean}. POST /v1/issues/:id/resolve continues {resolutionNote} and optionally {basis:'latest_observation'|'manual_confirmation',observationId?:uuid}. Backboard and semantic search may be unavailable; show honest unavailable state, no fake results. Root will notify final contracts. Walk uses sessionStorage/localStorage; <=5 issues; mark visited only when an observation is actually saved. Geolocation on explicit action only; manual location supported. Capture image resize1600, preserve retries/idempotency, clear external processing consent, all model suggestions human-confirmed. Fetch caps max5MB may get app-config actual settings, keep image compressed. Use actual current endpoints not guessed. Current backend /app-config capability fields audio,mock,storage,accessRequired,retentionNotice. API responses inspect source. All uncertainty explain in final report. Accessibility reduced motion focus keyboard labels, mobile360+, comparison slider and side-by-side, field-journal visual tokens specified PRD. Spend care on landing hero THE WORLD / HAS OPEN ISSUES with editorial map/contour motifs and subtle scroll reveals, avoid dashboard-on-landing/fake statistics. Implement fully, run web build and typecheck, fix failures. Deliver concise report files changed, checks, gaps. Do not wait for root approval to proceed.
Contracts confirmed (resolve uses `note` + `basis` + `observationId`; SPA bundle only serves `dist/assets/*`). Writing the theme and core libs now.
Core libs done. Now the shared field components (status, observation image, slider, timeline, map).
Shell done. Now the public side: landing hero with contour/walking-path motif, then About, Methodology, Privacy.
Walk done. Now the Model Lab, then routing.
Root's Backboard response omits `model` on complete results and reads `complete[0].result.category` after spreading, which likely throws; I'll flag that. Wiring both into the Lab defensively.
Build passes. Splitting the app shell out of the landing chunk, then checking whether a local API is up for a real browser pass.

Root coordinator update: browser testing is mine through the required CUA browser tool. Stop exploring Playwright/local browser runtimes; do not run any browser automation or install browser tools. Finish typecheck/build, then copy your staged apps/web implementation into the actual repository and update only root package.json/package-lock.json as assigned. You are not alone; preserve all root backend and Docker changes. Root now has real working Backboard and Tiger adapters. IMPORTANT: Backboard response results are [{status:'complete',model,provider,promptVersion,inputModality:'text',result:{category,severity,rationale,evidence},latencyMs,inputTokens,outputTokens,costUsd,createdAt,cached}], with nested result; your panel currently reads flat r.category etc and must fix this. Show provenance, response time, evidence and independent errors. Tiger endpoint matches your existing semantic API. Resolution body {note,basis,observationId} matches current API. Add ISSUЕ_UPDATED history renderer (ASCII event type ISSUE_UPDATED) for payload {source,edits:{title:{before,after},description:{before,after}}}. Do not claim original AI objects/conditions can be edited (they are immutable); human classification/category/severity can. Landing hero check long line responsive, no browser. Do not wait for root or ask user questions. Finish integration into actual repo and give report with checks/gaps, then stop. Root will do actual UI acceptance and independent audit. Do not run root full tests; root will run those after integration.
Now the Backboard nested-result fix, ISSUE_UPDATED renderer, review copy and hero sizing.
